body: OWNER-CLARIFIED SHERLOCK STORAGE/SHARING POLICY (2026-08-31): the only Sherlock artifact barred from storage in Git and redistribution is the actual raw episode video file content. Everything else may be stored and shared, including annotations, recall transcripts and exports, aliases and transformation receipts, source/recall graphs, features, reports, model outputs, and other derived Sherlock data. This directly supersedes the broader non-redistribution interpretation in post-01M1CMDBD1M7BZTVECYC0DM77V and any existing ADR/roadmap/court text that places annotations, recalls, derived artifacts, or the scientific workflow behind a new licence, consent, or REB hold. Keep the raw video bytes local/external and excluded; exact media identity, edition/two-part binding, timestamps, transformations, segmentation coordinate (1000 microsegments vs 50 Chen scenes vs 30 recall-tuned events), provenance, admission-checklist, uncertainty, and anti-circularity requirements remain scientific gates. Record this as owner project policy, not as a court adjudication of copyright or a claim that a film licence was obtained. The intake successor must amend the conflicting ADR/roadmap/court language so downstream implementation is no longer blocked on the superseded restriction.
